author: BigDonkey
quote: Wow, I waited 13 years for a game where I’m back in a toxic relationship that I bought the game to escape from for a few days. I gave it 10 hours but the forced relationship with an abusive woman who treats Jason like a life accessory has left a sour taste in my mouth.Currently in a fight with JB Hi-Fi to get a refund as I’m not willing to support the abusive feminist message.
